title: Bridging Machine Learning and Clinical Endpoints: A METABRIC-Informed Simulation Study of Missing Data Imputation for RECIST-Based Best Overall Response
caption: Waterfall plot of best percent change from baseline in tumor size for individual patients from the Gompertz-simulated dataset, stratified by HER2 status. Each bar represents the maximum tumor reduction (or minimum percent change) observed for a patient across all follow-up visits up to 48 months, ordered from greatest reduction to greatest increase. Horizontal dashed lines indicate RECIST thresholds for partial response (−30%) and progressive disease (+20%).
